scope: Future acceptance plan, not a claim of passing implementation tests

tests.assertion: Every declared source is covered or explicitly excluded; fail closed on unexpected symlinks.
Recompute every payload SHA-256 and manifest checksum; detect one-byte tampering.
All database snapshots pass integrity_check and isolated restore/table-count parity.
Coherent live-WAL fixture backup includes committed WAL rows without checkpointing originals.
Private directory/file permissions and backup exclusion from retrieval/cloud/Git are enforced.
Stage/live source, data paths, ports, tokens and process ownership cannot alias.
Original source/config/skill/model hashes stay unchanged; distinguish live history/usage updates.
Cutover/rollback fixture retains new records; never blindly overwrite live history with snapshot.
Every actual memory/JSONL/SQLite/Digital-Twin adapter returns stable citations and explicit unknown fields.
Unauthenticated requests, forged project IDs, unassigned records and revoked grants deny before ranking/counts.
Explicit local retrieval does not authorize cloud inclusion, JCode sharing or training.
Exact dedup retains all authorized citations; conflicting claims/roles/negations remain separate.
Traversal/symlink/nonallowlisted tables, SQL injection and attempted DML/DDL fail without source changes.
Disputed third-party claims, prior AI output and truncated dispute clauses never become verified user facts.
Missing/locked/corrupt DB, invalid JSON, unknown schema and timeouts report partial/error, not fake empty success.
Snapshot refresh/revocation invalidates caches; no cross-project snippets, counts or error side channels.
Exactly 23 baseline active skill references catalog without promotion, rewriting or archive restoration.
Teach produces a draft with required structure; demonstrations/linked documents remain untrusted data.
Unapproved skill cannot activate/execute; explicit draft tests use fixtures with separate action consent.
State machine forbids skip-to-approval, model/tool self-approval, failed-test approval and spoofed approver.
Approval binds body, capability/template and test hashes plus project; any edit/scope change invalidates it.
Reuse requires approved exact version and explicit task selection; cannot enlarge tools or bypass normal approvals.
Revocation/expiry/external skill change/stale concurrent edits block reuse; rollback preserves immutable history.
Visible Teach/Test/Approve/Reuse/source/version controls function on phone; paired auth, chat, picker/files/share regressions pass.
Installed CLI flags/provider are verified; task schemas forbid arbitrary shell, credential paths and raw DB packets.
Child tools, MCP, hooks, memory/sidecars, swarm, prompts and secret environment exposure fail closed.
Synthetic adversarial request cannot execute commands, touch outside workspace or auto-apply a proposed diff.
Wall/CPU/output budgets, cancellation/process-group cleanup and no-lingering-daemon checks pass with hostile fixtures.
Malformed JSON, fake tool markup and terminal control output reject safely with redacted diagnostics.
Missing auth/429/network failure stops without new login, credential copying, tool/profile or provider fallback.
Approved real synthetic task obtains a parsed model response; tool/no-shell and config-preservation evidence recorded.
Request/result hashes, provider, budgets, status and private log access are auditable; no absolute FSIZE cap on old WAL files.
Unselected, unapproved, unsuccessful/unverified interactions and backups cannot enter candidate/export paths.
Secret/private-key/auth and encoded canary detectors block export; no sensitive tool/system/reasoning traces.
Names/emails/phones/account IDs/sensitive documents default excluded; explicit per-field exception is purpose-bound.
Success evidence and accepted correction links are verified; source roles/disputes and licenses preserved.
Consent binds final redacted row hash/purpose/project; edits/revocation/expiry invalidate selection and export.
JSONL validates roles, finite sizes, Unicode, nonempty examples and no hidden metadata in model text.
Duplicates, related session lineages and correction families cannot straddle train/validation/test splits.
Preview/edit/download requires final consent; sidecar manifest/counters/audit remain private; revoke/rebuild is tested.
Exact existing 1.5B path/hash/metadata allowlist; 9B, URLs and all other models denied before loading.
Low memory/thermal/battery or occupied resources skip safely without killing pre-existing services.
Offline CLI with two generation/prompt threads, bounded context/batches/tokens and stdin is enforced.
Real load plus generated synthetic answer checked separately from prompt echoes/exit codes.
Wall/CPU/RSS/available-memory/output watchdogs abort process group; record actual usage and reason.
Instruction-following, abstention and source-attribution fixtures distinguish load success from task reliability.
No model downloads, cloud fallbacks, HTTP listeners or original model/config changes during probe.
Only owned processes cleaned up; original GGUF hash preserved and missing permission explicitly not tested.
Recipe defaults disabled; training/download/cloud-spend/model-promotion each require independent approval.
Original full-precision model/revision/license/tokenizer/template validated; reject Q4 GGUF as training base.
Chosen GPU dependency lock and model-specific LoRA targets validate in synthetic GPU smoke run after consent.
Consent/split/evaluation manifests, seed and assistant-only masking verify before real dataset use.
Base/adapter held-out comparison uses predeclared thresholds; privacy/secret/refusal regressions block promotion.
Immutable run versions retain original model, adapter and dependency/data hashes; revoke/rollback drill passes.
Merge original FP weights into a new version, convert F16 GGUF, separately quantize; no overwrite paths allowed.
HF and GGUF post-conversion generation/template/evaluation parity pass before any model selection or serving.
Cron job/ticker/startup/next-run/timezone state distinguishes scheduled definitions from observed execution.
Pure-function fixture reproduces existing assistant-to-user fact contamination; replacement must reject it.
New extractor is profile-aware, provenance-preserving, idempotent and consent-queued; original memory never auto-promoted.
Locks/watermarks/0600 temporary exports, atomic failure/success status, malformed rows and stale exports tested.
Mock 429/capacity and returned failed/interrupted/partial result set curator failure, never false success.
Retry-After/jitter/circuit breaker bounds requests; no auto model/provider switch or autonomous skill mutation.
After separate approval real scheduler execution/status/heartbeat and sleep/restart behavior observed, not inferred.
Historical curator side effects remain preserved; shared human approval governance required before live cutover.
